EU MAR.title: EU MAR
EU MAR.description: EU Market Abuse Regulation (MAR): Regulation 596/2014 as amended by the Listing Act, CS MAD, the Commission delegated and implementing acts (STORs, manipulation indicators, market soundings, insider lists, managers' transactions, buy-backs, AMPs), ESMA Q&As and MAR guidelines (incl. the 2026 delay guidelines). Search in plain language or by citation; articles returned with their Level 2 rules and ESMA interpretation; MAR-REMIT crosswalk for energy and commodity firms; sources checked daily. Read-only, no auth.
